nbaInjuries.name: Anthony Edwards
nbaInjuries.note: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.

nbaInjuries.name: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
nbaInjuries.note: Gilgeous-Alexander (back/neck) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game versus Miami.

nbaInjuries.name: Giannis Antetokounmpo
nbaInjuries.note: Antetokounmpo (groin) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against Oklahoma City, Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sun Sentinel rep

nbaInjuries.name: Stephen Curry
nbaInjuries.note: Curry has been diagnosed with an oblique abdominal tear and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

nbaInjuries.name: Jayson Tatum
nbaInjuries.note: Tatum (rest) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Kings.

nbaInjuries.name: Cade Cunningham
nbaInjuries.note: Cunningham (knee) is probable to play Sunday in Atlanta.

nbaInjuries.name: Paolo Banchero
nbaInjuries.note: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

nbaInjuries.name: Pascal Siakam
nbaInjuries.note: Siakam (hip) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against New York.

nbaInjuries.name: Jaylen Brown
nbaInjuries.note: Brown (hamstring) went through individual work during Friday's practice, Tony Jones of The Athletic reports.

nbaInjuries.name: Tyrese Haliburton
nbaInjuries.note: Haliburton (hamstring) is expected to miss at least two more weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
